item.name: List all instances for an MCP server

request.name: List all instances for an MCP server

description.content: Retrieves a paginated list of user instances (user IDs) associated with a specific Model Control Protocol (MCP) server. This endpoint supports pagination to handle servers with many instances.

query.description: Search instances by user ID/instance ID

variable.description: (Required) The ID of the MCP server

response.name: Successfully retrieved MCP server instances. Returns the list of user IDs associated with this server.

item.name: Delete an MCP server instance and associated connected accounts

request.name: Delete an MCP server instance and associated connected accounts

description.content: Removes a user instance from the MCP server and deletes all connected accounts for that user that are associated with the auth configurations of this specific MCP server. Connected accounts for other auth configurations are not affected.

variable.description: (Required) The ID of the MCP server
(Required) The instance ID (user ID) to delete
